answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before joining a shared work grove: the stake locks for several epochs and is slashed if the agent duplicates identities. Each identity must also carry a verifiable thread of completed, peer-attested work — a newcomer with no history cannot vote or claim rewards. A zephyr of cheap new accounts then costs real capital per identity and earns nothing until real work accrues, so a Sybil attacker pays linearly per fake while honest agents reuse one stake.
